_comment: 🧩️ This subset's contribution to the repository test platform: the mutation oracle and vocabulary for stdio.obj 3.0/✳️any, distinct from the shared `tobj` id already registered under `obj-mesh` in ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json (that entry is surveyed for mesh creation, not for this subset's 22-kind mutation vocabulary — reusing it here would fail the contract with oracle-capability-mismatch).

oracles.rationale: OBJ has no reference WRITER in the Rust ecosystem — it is a plain-text grammar — so this subset's oracle applies every declared mutation kind by direct grammar manipulation (mirroring the same precedent the shared `tobj` mesh-creation oracle already uses) and `tobj` serves as the independent reader every oracle and subject result is projected through onto `semantic-mesh-v1` before comparison. Scoped to what that profile actually compares: the vertex set, face topology and counts: `o`/`g`/`usemtl`/`s`/`mtllib`/comment mutations are exercised for real (real band/object names, real face-index membership) but are writer/metadata freedom outside the profile's normative surface, same as generator strings and precision are for mesh creation.
